get_config: get the MXNet default mean and std preprocessing config for a named network
build_get_config: build a python module that returns MXNet default mean and std values for image preprocessing
test_get_config: test the get_config function to verify it returns correct mean and std values
refactor_get_config: refactor the get_config function to support custom mean and std values via kwargs
review_get_config: review the get_config function and its MXNet default preprocessing configuration values
